additionalProperties.description:
Metadata for a tile source in the catalog.

Contains information needed to properly serve tiles from a source,
including HTTP headers and human-readable metadata.

attribution.description: Attribution text for the data source

content_type.description: MIME type for the tile data (e.g., "application/x-protobuf", "image/png")

description.description: Description of the tile source content

last_modified_at.description: Timestamp of the underlying source's last modification.

layer_count.description: Number of vector layers declared by this source.

name.description: Human-readable name for the tile source

tile_grid.description: Tile grid the source is served in, when it is not the default Web Mercator grid

Collection.description: A tile source as an OGC API collection.

crs.description: The CRSs the collection is served in, only the CRS of its grid.

storageCrs.description: The CRS of the collection's grid.

Collections.description: The collections the OGC API serves.

Conformance.description: The conformance declaration of the OGC API.

DataType.description: What a source's tiles hold, in the terms of OGC API - Tiles.

Extent.description: Where a collection's or the dataset's data lies.

FeatureCollectionTag.description:
`"FeatureCollection"` discriminator for the top-level body. A unit enum so
any other `type` (a bare `Feature`, `Geometry`, or garbage) fails to
deserialize with a clear serde error.

FeatureTag.description: `"Feature"` discriminator for each member of the collection.

FontFormat.description:
Source font file container format.

The string serialization (serde and `strum`) is the lowercase file
extension, so [`FontFormat::VARIANTS`] doubles as the list of recognised
font extensions and [`str::parse`] maps an extension back to a variant.

LandingPage.description: The entry point of the OGC API.

extent.description: Where the data of all collections lies.

Layer.description: A layer of a vector tileset.

Link.description: A link from one OGC API resource to another.

SpatialExtent.description: The bounding box of a collection or the dataset, in longitude and latitude and in the CRS of a collection's grid.

storageCrsBbox.description: `bbox` in the CRS of the collection's grid, in its axis order.

StaticOverlayFeature.description:
Wire shape of one `GeoJSON` `Feature`. A `null`/missing geometry is kept as
`None` and skipped at apply time.

oneOf.description: Styling for this feature. All fields optional; unknown fields ignored.

StaticOverlayProperties.description:
Wire shape of a feature's `properties`, keyed by canonical `MapLibre`
paint/layout names. Colors arrive as strings and are parsed in [`TryFrom`];
enums and numbers are validated by serde. Unknown keys (`id`, `name`,
`title`, …) are ignored.

circle-radius.description: Radius in pixels at the rendered scale.

line-width.description: Line width in pixels at the rendered scale.

StaticStyleOverlay.description:
Wire shape of the top-level body: a `GeoJSON` `FeatureCollection`. Doubles as
the `OpenAPI` request-body schema.

features.description: Features to overlay on the rendered base map, in draw order.

StyleDescription.description: A style in the list, linking to its stylesheets.

StyleKind.description: What kind of layers a `MapLibre` style draws.

Styles.description: The styles the OGC API serves.

TileMatrix.description: One zoom level of a tile matrix set.

TileMatrixLimits.description: The tiles of one zoom that hold data.

TileMatrixSet.description: A tile matrix set in the JSON encoding of OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set 2.0.

TileMatrixSetItem.description: One tile matrix set in the list, linking to its definition.

TileMatrixSets.description: The tile matrix sets the OGC API serves.

TileSetItem.description: A tileset in a list, linking to its metadata.

TileSets.description: The tilesets of a collection, map or style.
